title: Beyond Accuracy: A Geometric Stability Analysis of Large Language Models in Chess Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2512.15033v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated in chess by how closely their position evaluations agree with a strong engine, but such agreement does not show that a model evaluates equivalent positions consistently. We apply metamorphic relations to chess evaluation: a 180-degree rotation of pawnless positions, left-right mirroring, color swapping, position pairs one move apart, conversion between Forsyth-Edwards Notation and a natural-language description, and illegal positions. Six LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek Chat, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5.1, Grok 4.1 Fast and Kimi K2 Turbo) evaluated seven test sets of 500 items each, with Stockfish 16.1 as the reference. All six models failed on rotation: at most 10.6% of the 500 rotated pairs received evaluations within 300 centipawns (cp) of each other, and the models often declared the legal rotated positions illegal. translated_title: 超越准确率：大语言模型在国际象棋评估中的几何稳定性分析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通常通过其局面评估与强大引擎评估结果的一致程度来在国际象棋任务中进行评估，但这种一致性并不能证明模型对等价局面的评估是一致的。我们将蜕变关系应用于国际象棋评估：无兵局面的180度旋转、左右镜像、黑白互换、相差一步的局面对、FEN记号与自然语言描述之间的相互转换，以及非法局面。六个大语言模型（Claude Sonnet 4.5、DeepSeek Chat、Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5.1、Grok 4.1 Fast和Kimi K2 Turbo）对七个各含500个项目的测试集进行了评估，并以Stockfish 16.1作为参考基准。所有六个模型在旋转变换上均告失败：500个旋转局面中最多只有10.6%的对子评估结果彼此相差在300厘兵以内，且模型常常将旋转后的合法局面判定为非法。在其他四种变换上，稳定性对模型的排名为……
tldr: 该论文首次将蜕变关系用于检验大语言模型国际象棋评估的几何稳定性，发现六大主流模型在180度旋转等价局面的测试中集体失败——最多仅10.6%的旋转对评估偏差在300厘兵以内，且常常将合法的旋转局面误判为非法。
en_tdlr: This paper applies metamorphic relations to test the geometric stability of LLMs in chess evaluation, revealing that all six major models fail on rotated positions—at most 10.6% of the 500 rotated pairs agree within 300 centipawns—and often misjudge legal rotated positions as illegal.
